data.body:
[P1] Preserve quarantine across runs when retirement fails

A case can stop its durable execution while an invocation-owned task remains alive. The coordinator then calls `finish(..., quiescent=False)`, but this implementation discards that signal. Once the Actions job ends, the next deployment checks only for RUNNING executions and can update the same persistent target despite its unretired workers. Persist target quarantine and require subsequent preparation/deployment to reconcile the prior runtime work before clearing it. Add a two-run regression with a terminal execution and an unexited task.
